target.approvedName: mitochondrially encoded NADH:ubiquinone oxidoreductase core subunit 5
functionDescriptions: Core subunit of the mitochondrial membrane respiratory chain NADH dehydrogenase (Complex I) which catalyzes electron transfer from NADH through the respiratory chain, using ubiquinone as an electron acceptor (PubMed:15250827). Essential for the catalytic activity and assembly of complex I (PubMed:15250827). .
